market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a tug-of-war: oil relief from Iran/Hormuz supports equities, but 5% bond yields and mortgage stress cap upside. Expect range-bound action with volatility spikes on oil headlines and Fed commentary. 80/20 concentration may widen before correcting. Nike and consumer names remain vulnerable into Q1 earnings.
market_outlook.long_term: The 5% yield regime is likely structural absent a major growth shock. AI capex cycle supports tech leadership but fragmentation (AMD vs. Nvidia, orbital vs. terrestrial compute) creates rotation opportunities. US-China truce buys 2 months but rare earths dependency is a persistent structural risk. Housing affordability crisis deepens with mortgage rates at 2-year highs.
